messages.snippet: Privileged & confidential — internal only. My read on where to land with Sterling: (1) pricing — con
messages.subject: Northwind — negotiation strategy (internal, privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Privileged & confidential — internal only.

My read on where to land with Sterling: (1) pricing — concede 4.25% on A and 6.50% on B, that's the market and the client can live with it; (2) covenants — hold the line at 3.50x→3.00x and DSCR 1.10x, the 2.75x step is unrealistic on Marlow's downside; (3) liquidity floor at £1.5m, not £1.75m; (4) exit fee at 1.00%. Amendment fee meet in the middle at £285k.

Watch the directors' duties angle — make sure the board minutes record the creditor-interest analysis properly given the company is in the zone. Elena, please get the security documents finalised in parallel so we're not on the critical path at completion.

Sarah
